_about.purpose: Manually verified retrieval evaluation set for Phase 5.0.
_about.corpus: Rutgers 2026-27 dev database: 4,415 courses, 243 subjects, 88 catalog descriptions (CS only).
_about.relevance_scope: Relevance is scoped to UNDERGRADUATE New Brunswick courses (level 'U', offering unit '01') unless a query names a specific course. CoursePilot plans SAS undergraduate degrees, so a graduate section surfacing for a student query is a wrong answer, not a near-miss. Labels were enumerated from the real corpus, not guessed.
_about.caveat: 98% of courses have a title and no description. Conceptual and description-oriented queries are therefore bounded by what a ~27-character uppercase title contains. Weak scores on those types are a statement about the SOURCE DATA, not automatically about the retrieval method.
_about.authority: This set measures RETRIEVAL only. Whether a course satisfies a requirement is decided by the deterministic Degree Engine, never by search.
